status_definitions.complete: Requested implementation exists and is covered by an executable check.
status_definitions.partial: Useful implementation exists, but requested framework/subgraph/tensor coverage is incomplete.
status_definitions.missing: The requested implementation has not been added.
status_definitions.blocked: Code may exist, but validation cannot be completed in the declared A10/current environment.

requirements.requirement: Enumerate common high-share LLM subgraphs and their operator structure.
requirements.gap: The catalog is shape/config-derived rather than a measured operator-time share decomposition of full models.

requirements.requirement: Enumerate Diffusion subgraphs with real model shapes and full operator structure.
requirements.gap: The 2025-2026 corpus and common motif shape grid now exist, but exact per-model tensor shapes still need to be joined from the user's ONNX files and complete model-specific denoise blocks remain absent.

requirements.requirement: Explain the layout decision owner and method in SGLang, vLLM, CUTLASS, Triton, TVM and Hexcute.
requirements.gap: The decision taxonomy has been checked against pinned current commits. Each future run resolves again because upstream behavior can change.

requirements.requirement: Record every relevant operator/tensor/load/store/KV-cache layout selected by every framework for every subgraph.
requirements.gap: Graph-boundary tensor layouts and compiler dump evidence are now normalized, but they do not reconstruct every shared/register layout or associate every load/store with a logical tensor. Serving systems also delegate many decisions to backends.

requirements.requirement: Provide GitHub source evidence for why each framework chooses a layout.
requirements.gap: All six remote repositories produced commit-pinned exact file/line hits on 2026-09-13. Moving repositories and unmatched future patterns are retained explicitly rather than replaced with guessed evidence.

requirements.requirement: Use controlled paired experiments where only layout policy changes.
requirements.gap: Controlled kernels cover KV, shared-bank, reduction, SwiGLU packing and Conv; native paired layout kernels for MLA, MoE, sparse attention, linear attention and Mamba2 are not implemented.

requirements.requirement: Run SGLang-native per-subgraph layout experiments.
requirements.gap: The native server adapter now compares SGLang NHD/HND with backend/page/model/requests fixed and separately keeps FlashInfer/Triton/page-policy changes marked confounded. Native per-640-subgraph isolation remains absent.

requirements.requirement: Run vLLM-native per-subgraph layout experiments.
requirements.gap: A native server adapter now forces the current VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT candidates and captures the server's resolved layout, but unsupported layouts may be rejected and native per-640-subgraph kernel isolation remains absent.

requirements.requirement: Run CUTLASS layout variants for every target subgraph.
requirements.gap: CUTLASS coverage is currently the reduction/softmax boundary only; GEMM/SwiGLU, grouped MoE, attention/MLA, scan and Diffusion block adapters are absent.

requirements.requirement: Run Triton layout variants and complete LLM subgraphs.
requirements.gap: Explicit layout control exists for QK/KV only. The 640-case path uses TorchInductor/Triton but does not enumerate or normalize all internal layout decisions.

requirements.requirement: Run TVM layout variants for every target subgraph.
requirements.gap: Only an explicit row-major/tiled reduction exists; MetaSchedule/IndexMap adapters for attention, FFN, MoE, scan and Diffusion are absent.

requirements.requirement: Run Hexcute layout synthesis for every target subgraph on card 1.
requirements.gap: Only the upstream artifact wrapper/source audit exists. The public artifact targets A100/H100 and does not establish A10 support; no local per-case Hexcute adapter maps the 640-case contract.

requirements.requirement: Measure current performance of the 640 LLM cases with comparable correctness and result storage.
requirements.gap: Historical result files are deliberately not source dependencies. A clean clone must generate a new timestamped result directory with the registered runner.

requirements.requirement: Measure complete Diffusion subgraph/end-to-end denoise-block performance.
requirements.gap: Reference runners now cover patch/3D patch, VAE boundary, attention, FFN, modulation, RoPE, QK-Norm and structured attention layouts; complete model-specific DiT blocks and cross-denoise-step persistence remain unsupported.

requirements.requirement: Capture and analyze load/store instructions, vector width, memory transactions and compiler layouts.
requirements.gap: SASS/PTX/Triton-layout evidence is now normalized per dump file, but records are not yet joined to every operator/tensor identity and Hexcute/CuTe type layouts need framework-specific decoders.

requirements.requirement: Implement a better layout decision algorithm and demonstrate speedup over current framework policy.
requirements.gap: An exact finite graph-level optimizer and greedy counterexample are implemented, but it does not yet rewrite any of the six frameworks and its costs have not been replaced with paired GPU measurements; therefore no framework speedup claim is yet possible.

requirements.requirement: Separate scientific questions from engineering work and define falsification criteria.
requirements.gap: Empirical falsification awaits GPU execution.

requirements.requirement: Provide one Bash command fixed to physical GPU 1 and continue past unavailable frameworks.
requirements.gap: A CUDA-enabled card-1 run is still required; dependency environments are not installed by the script.

requirements.requirement: Store environment, raw results, failures, source revisions and reports in analysis-friendly files.
requirements.gap: A normalized single table joining source decisions, counters and latency is not yet implemented.

requirements.requirement: Use statistically defensible performance methodology.
requirements.gap: P20/P50/P80 and warmups exist, but there are no independent-process repetitions, confidence intervals, randomized candidate order or clock/thermal controls across all experiments.

requirements.requirement: Actually execute all enabled experiments on physical card 1.
requirements.gap: The current workspace cannot communicate with the NVIDIA driver. Execution must occur when card 1 and the intended Python environments are available.

requirements.requirement: Incorporate the supplied shared ChatGPT/Codex discussions.
requirements.gap: All ten HTTPS share pages are now content-validated and the modern vision corpus uses their 12-family taxonomy. The codex:// thread is a separate local-client reference and has not been programmatically imported.

requirements.requirement: Define a 2025-2026 modern image/video generation corpus and compute >=50% motif incidence without counting variants twice.
requirements.gap: The corpus is a deliberately bounded 12-family sample, not an industry-wide census; adding a model changes the denominator and must regenerate the report.

requirements.requirement: Provide multiple image/video workload shape regimes for every >=50% visual motif.
requirements.gap: The 83 rows are explicit benchmark-policy regimes. They must not be described as exact per-model shapes until matched to ONNX evidence.

requirements.requirement: Extract exact tensor shapes and motif witnesses from the user's generated vision ONNX models.
requirements.gap: The extractor is implemented, but VISION_ONNX_ROOT and an optional ONNX-to-model map have not been supplied/run. Heuristic matches require review before incidence accounting.

requirements.requirement: Provide executable paired-layout reference workloads for every >=50% visual motif and preserve unsupported complete-block cases explicitly.
requirements.gap: Reference kernels cover the primitive motif boundaries. Complete model-specific DiT and dual+single blocks are explicitly unsupported, and native SGLang/vLLM/CUTLASS/Triton/TVM/Hexcute visual adapters are still missing.

requirements.requirement: Compute framework-by-subgraph coverage and native-layout regret without inventing an unobserved native layout.
requirements.gap: The 4,338-cell matrix and regret guardrails pass CPU smoke tests; meaningful empirical regret remains unavailable until native rows and at least one legal alternative are produced for the same case/framework.

requirements.requirement: Keep supplied ChatGPT and Codex references as correctly separated URLs and content-validate every HTTPS share.
requirements.gap: HTTP availability is time-dependent, so the one-command runner repeats the validation and stores the result with each experiment.

requirements.requirement: Resolve mutable official visual-model source links to immutable repository revisions for each run.
requirements.gap: All twelve sources resolved successfully on 2026-09-13. Availability and branch heads are time-dependent, so every one-command run writes a fresh immutable snapshot and retains individual failures.
